outcome: Duration of first stage of labor
Duration of second stage of labor
Duration of third stage of labor
cohort: 512 women admitted in spontaneous preterm labor with viable singleton gestations between 24 and 36+6 weeks, and 8,339 women with term spontaneous labors, from a single center
finding: The second stage of labor was significantly shorter in extremely preterm labors compared to later preterm and term labors, while first and third stage durations remained consistent across gestational ages; multiparous women experienced shorter first and second stages of labor compared to nulliparous women.
